item.text:
I'll review each evidence candidate against its excerpt and return one verdict per evidence_id.

---

**EF-E69a84ba7d960** (FOBAPROA / Truth Commission)

Claim: Por el Bien de Todos platform proposed FOBAPROA be investigated by a Truth Commission.
Excerpt: "En cuanto a las actividades del FOBAPROA, serían investigadas por una Comisión de la Verdad."
Locator: extracted HTML block 30.

Verdict: **Accept.** The excerpt directly supports the claim that the platform proposed a Truth Commission to investigate FOBAPROA. Attribution to CIDOB biography summarizing the platform is consistent. The platform-era period_fit and source limitations (no implementation evidence) are appropriately flagged.

---

**EF-E3a8af4b495c2** (2006 campaign launch in Metlatónoc)

Claim: López Obrador launched his 2006 presidential campaign on 19 January in Metlatónoc, Guerrero, a Mixtec indigenous municipality considered the poorest in the country.
Excerpt: "El 19 de enero el postulante perredista arrancó su campaña en Metlatónoc, municipio de Guerrero poblado por indígenas mixtecas y considerado el más pobre del país."
Locator: extracted HTML block 28.

Verdict: **Accept.** Date (19 January), year (2006 implied by PRD candidacy pre-Calderón), place (Metlatónoc, Guerrero), and "poorest in the country" description are all directly in the excerpt. Attribution and period_fit notes are accurate.

---

**EF-Ebd36774739f0** (PRD social-development programs)

Claim: PRD program proposed expanding public services to underserved areas, addressing elderly/unemployed/single mothers, and fostering productive activities (agriculture, tourism, public works).
Excerpt confirms all four elements (extensión de servicios públicos a áreas degradadas, atención a ancianos/parados/madres solteras, fomento agropecuario/turístico/obras públicas).
Locator: extracted HTML block 31.

Verdict: **Accept.** Excerpt fully supports the claim. Mechanism/outcome `[not separately decomposed]` is correctly flagged as a platform statement, not implementation.

---

**EF-E2a25400d34a4** (Morena 2018 program: pensions, refineries, energy reform reversal, guarantee prices)

Claim: 1,500 pesos older-adult pensions; increase domestic gasoline supply/bring refineries into service; review/null/reverse Peña Nieto energy reform; energy and food self-sufficiency with guarantee prices.
Excerpt verifies each element including 1,500-peso pension figure, refinery proposal, comprehensive review of energy reform, autosuficiencia energética y alimentaria, and precios de garantía for producers.
Locator: extracted HTML block 62.

Verdict: **Accept.** All quantities and proposals are directly supported by the excerpt.

---

**EF-E4ceda096a594** (PRD program: Pemex shield, three refineries)

Claim: Shield state ownership of Pemex; hydrocarbons exclusively in national service; explore/exploit all viable reserves; build three large refineries to reduce imports.
Excerpt confirms blindaje de titularidad estatal, exploration/exploitation of viable reserves, construcción de tres grandes refinerías para reducir importaciones.
Locator: extracted HTML block 47.

Verdict: **Accept.** Excerpt fully supports the claim.

---

**EF-E11d0ff7f20d3** (Electricity privatizations reversal, renewables, lower tariffs)

Claim: Halt/reverse privatizations in generation/transmission/distribution; promote renewables under energy transition; lower tariffs/product prices.
Excerpt confirms detener y revertir privatizaciones, impulsar energías alternativas/renovables, política de transición energética, rebajar tarifas y precios.
Locator: extracted HTML block 47.

Verdict: **Accept.** All three elements are directly supported.

---

**EF-E973033d820db** (Proyecto Alternativo de Nación, 10 points)

Claim: Ten-point program with items on new economy, combating monopolies, and abolishing fiscal privileges.
Excerpt lists all ten points; points 5 (nueva economía), 6 (combatir monopolios), and 7 (abolir privilegios fiscales para redistribuir riqueza con justicia) are present.
Locator: extracted HTML block 46.

Verdict: **Accept.** Excerpt directly supports the enumerated points attributed to the Proyecto Alternativo de Nación.

---

**EF-Eb675ff361c48** (2012 socioeconomic pledges)

Claim: 6% annual growth, 1.2 million jobs/year, eradicate hunger, food self-sufficiency, raise minimum wages above inflation, popular housing, universal coverage (education including university, health, pensions for adults over 68 and persons with disabilities).
Excerpt verifies every quantity and policy: 6% growth, 1.2 million jobs/año, autosuficiencia alimentaria, salarios mínimos por encima de inflación, vivienda popular, cobertura pública universal (universitario, salud, pensiones adultos mayores de 68 años, personas con discapacidad).
Locator: extracted HTML block 48.

Verdict: **Accept.** All elements and quantities are directly supported.

---

**EF-Efac9797fa4d6** (Morena 2018: austerity, no tax hikes, no debt, 171 pesos minimum wage)

Claim: Republican austerity; no taxes raised (some selective decreases in northern border states only) and no debt issued; gradual minimum-wage increase to 171 pesos; equivalent increase for older-adult pensions.
Excerpt confirms austeridad republicana, sin subir ningún impuesto (bajas sólo en estados fronterizos con EU), sin emitir deuda, salario mínimo gradual hasta 171 pesos, pensiones de adultos mayores "y lo mismo".
Locator: extracted HTML block 62.

Verdict: **Accept.** Excerpt directly supports every element; the 1,500-peso pension quantity noted is corroborated by EF-E2a25400d34a4.

---

**EF-E3ed61806def0** (Victory-speech anti-corruption / pro-poor pledge)

Claim: Victory speech said government would prioritize poor/forgotten/Indigenous people; no corruption or impunity, including for allies, officials, friends, family.
Excerpt: full quoted text of "daremos preferencia a los más humildes y olvidados; en especial, a los pueblos indígenas... Bajo ninguna circunstancia, el próximo presidente permitirá la corrupción ni la impunidad... sea quien sea, será castigado. Incluyo a compañeros de lucha, funcionarios, amigos y familiares."
Locator: extracted HTML block 65.

Verdict: **Accept** as a faithful record of what was stated in the speech. Date is reasonable (post-election victory speech, July 2018). The claim appropriately frames this as a stated pledge; the source_limitations correctly note coverage ends August 2018 and the statement is not evidence of enforcement.

---

**EF-E52012ddbab95** (2018 legislative supermajority)

Claim: Juntos Haremos Historia won 308/500 Deputies and 69/128 Senators — absolute majorities in both chambers.
Excerpt: "sumaban 308 escaños de 500 y en el Senado 69 escaños de 128."
Locator: extracted HTML block 66.

Verdict: **Accept.** Quantities match exactly. Period_fit and source_limitations correctly frame this as inherited capacity (2018), not direct evidence of 2022 policy quality — appropriate for question 5B.10.

---

**EF-Eb9c751db7fe6** (2018–2024 platform synthesis)

Claim: Platform combined support for free markets, free trade, macroeconomic stability, budget discipline, floating peso, central-bank autonomy with opposition to privatization/foreign ownership in strategic sectors and priorities for national production, domestic consumption, geographically broad growth.
Excerpt explicitly lists all elements: libre mercado, libre comercio, estabilidad macroeconómica, disciplina presupuestaria, flotación del peso, autonomía del Banco de México, rechazo al neoliberalismo/tendencias privatizadoras/extranjerización de sectores estratégicos, priorizar producción nacional, consumo interno, crecimiento horizontal.
Locator: extracted HTML block 63.

Verdict: **Accept.** Excerpt fully supports the mixed-polarity framing.

---

**EF-Ef3ee2bf47167** (Recall, free internet, gender equality, scholarships, Santa Lucía airport)

Claim: Legal recall mechanisms, removal of immunity for officials prosecuted for corruption, nationwide free internet, narrowing labor gender inequality, student scholarships (Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro), airport system at Santa Lucía instead of NAIM (excessive cost overruns and environmental impact).
Excerpt supports every element: revocación de mandatos, desafuero por corrupción, Internet libre y gratuito en todo el territorio, cerrar brechas de desigualdad laboral entre hombres y mujeres, becas Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro, Sistema Aeroportuario basado en Santa Lucía (no en NAIM, "polémico por sus exorbitantes sobrecostes y su impacto medioambiental").
Locator: extracted HTML block 64.

Verdict: **Accept.** All proposals and the NAIM critique are directly supported. The claim stays at the campaign-platform level (not implementation).

---

### Summary

All 13 evidence candidates are **accepted**. Each excerpt supports the complete claim, attribution, dates, quantities, and causal strength as stated. Where mechanism/outcome fields show `[not separately decomposed]`, the original passages indeed describe platform positions rather than implemented effects, and the claim wording (e.g., "proposed," "offered," "would") and source_limitations appropriately frame them as pledges, not outcomes. No rejection or escalation is warranted.
